TOP-DOWN OBLIQUE ORTHOGRAPHIC camera, horizontal facade, vertical posts, axis-aligned square-grid ground; no diamond isometric composition, painterly microtexture, blur/bloom, gradients, text or watermark. Four separated equal cells on transparent background: NELL front and rear, SEL front and rear, two DISTINCT original ADULT civilians, same small proportions. Nell is a female local labor clerk, NOT the original game character Neil. Proposed appearance: muted slate dress, oatmeal shawl, tied-back dark hair, small closed wage ledger held close. Sel is male apparatus workshop master: proposed worn russet work tunic, charcoal apron, greying short beard, leather belt with tongs, ordinary boots. No official badges, wizard outfits, heroic armor or huge weapons. Intended tiny40-pixel-like figures enlarged in chunky blocks, not portrait illustration. Match same person's clothing and size across views.
